name: nlp_mlm_pretrain
title: Masked-language-model pre-training from scratch: documents held out before packing, Trainer with an evaluation strategy and a masked-token metric
origin: hardening round 2, domain-nlp, 2026-09-14 - the shape round 1 never reached: pre-training rather than fine-tuning, a datasets.map packing chain, and a from-scratch AutoConfig model
note: The correct twin of nlp_mlm_pretrain_bad. Zero findings in both dataflow modes on 2026-09-14. Every forbidden row below names the line that makes the rule wrong here, so a regression in any of them is a false positive on textbook-correct HuggingFace pre-training code.

forbidden.why: transformers.set_seed(SEED) is called first in main() (line 67) and TrainingArguments carries seed= and data_seed= (lines 63-64)
split_documents passes seed=SEED to datasets' train_test_split (line 26)
the Trainer is given eval_dataset= and compute_metrics= (lines 76-78) and TrainingArguments sets eval_strategy="epoch" (line 56)
nothing in this project fits a transformer: the tokenizer is loaded from a pretrained checkpoint and applied, never fitted, and the held-out slice is cut before any encoding
the same - no FIT / FIT_TRANSFORM call exists anywhere in the workspace
there is no hand-written evaluation loop at all; trainer.evaluate() owns the eval pass and HuggingFace calls model.eval() inside it
the same - no torch loop exists in this workspace
compute_metrics takes np.argmax(logits, axis=-1) on line 35 before comparing against the labels
no DataLoader is constructed here; the Trainer builds its own and shuffles the training split by default
the same - there is no DataLoader in this workspace
no DataLoader and therefore no num_workers; main() is called from an if __name__ == "__main__" guard (line 89)
no .cuda() and no torch.device literal appears anywhere; bf16=True is a dtype, not a device
the checkpoint is written with trainer.save_model / tokenizer.save_pretrained (lines 84-85); torch.save and torch.load do not appear
no nn.Module subclass is defined in this workspace
the same - no module is defined, so no submodule can go unregistered

unsupported.defect: none - this row records that the correct ordering (split whole documents, then tokenize, then pack) is what makes the program clean
unsupported.why: no rule models block packing across a train/validation boundary, so the defective twin's version of this line cannot be labelled either

unsupported.defect: none - the tokenizer and the config come from the same literal CHECKPOINT
unsupported.why: MLV902 (tokenizer / checkpoint identifier mismatch) is a later-tier rule and is not built, so the correct pairing cannot be scored either
